name: Zais Hall
use: Army and Air Force ROTC; UNH ROTC Hall of Fame
style: Postwar one-and-a-half-story brick building with dormers (per reference photo)

facts.text: Dedicated October 14, 1978 for General Melvin Zais (class of 1937), then the highest-ranking UNH alumnus in the armed forces; it houses Army and Air Force ROTC.
The UNH ROTC Hall of Fame plaques are permanently displayed in Zais Hall.

verdict: 1948 brick building for ROTC, with a dormered roof and the ROTC Hall of Fame.
notes: Category corrected from academic to administration (ROTC program offices; arguably support). No licensed photo. Reference photo shows a modest red-brick building with a long dormered roof, a glazed vestibule and signage; utilitarian. Original 1948 use and any renovations unknown. Address 45 College Rd per search excerpt only.
